obligations.title: Annual LLC/partnership tax
obligations.applies_when: Domestic and foreign LLCs, LPs and GPs formed or registered in Delaware
obligations.form: Annual entity tax payment, no Annual Report required
obligations.due_rule: On or before June 1 for the prior year
obligations.quote:
All Domestic and Foreign Limited Liability Companies, Limited Partnerships, and General Partnerships formed or registered in Delaware are required to pay an annual tax of $400.00. There is no requirement to file an Annual Report.

The annual taxes for the prior year are due on or before June 1st.

notes: Annual LLC/LP/GP entity tax verified from the Division of Corporations instructions. The quoted amount is currently published, not a historical-year determination. The sales_tax entry is the official gross receipts taxability overview, not a sales tax filing obligation. Other obligations are not verified.
